draft.emotion: deep, steady, and sincere; the feeling of heart-felt commitment or intense warmth
notes: For people, 'amar' expresses deep romantic or familial devotion. In Mexico, 'querer' is much more common for everyday 'to love' with friends, family, or new partners.
In casual speech, 'amar' is also used hyperbolically for things you really enjoy (e.g., 'amo el café' — 'I love coffee'), though 'encantar' is more standard.
